C1707.title: Discussion of Defender for Cloud Apps Domain Allowlist False Positives
C1707.summary: In August 2023, an organization reported in a community forum a false-positive issue in the integration of the Azure AD domain allowlist with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: after configuring an allowlist to restrict file sharing to authorized domains, some file shares still triggered 'unauthorized domain' policy alerts, causing unnecessary alert and handling workload. The community discussion noted this may stem from Defender's differing handling of direct access versus link sharing, and is an alert-identification issue rather than a confirmed sensitive data breach.
